data.local_mode: Use local mode, where all values are calculated instead of retrieved

data.auto_update: Automatically update if new file is published online

data.days_before_today: Show events x days before today
data.days_after_today: Show events x days after today

data.enabled: Save data locally (enables offline mode and improves startup speed)
data.retention: How long to keep local data (in days)

is_holiday.name: Today is a holiday
is_holiday.description: Tests today's holiday names supplied by the calendar data source.

day.name: Holiday
day.description: Leave this filter disabled to match any holiday. Enable it to select a specific name.

is_holiday_eve.name: Today is a holiday eve
is_holiday_eve.description: Tests whether today is a holiday eve, including eves that the data source reports as holidays.

day.name: Holiday eve
day.description: Leave this filter disabled to match any holiday eve. Enable it to select a specific name.

is_flag_day.name: Today is a flag day
is_flag_day.description: Tests today's flag day names supplied by the calendar data source.

day.name: Flag day
day.description: Leave this filter disabled to match any flag day. Enable it to select a specific name.

calendar_data_unavailable.message: Today's calendar data is unavailable. Wait for the next successful update and try again.
